A serene Biblical scene by the Sea of Galilee. Two wooden fishing boats are at the shore. In one boat, Simon Peter is kneeling on fish-filled nets, looking up in awe at Jesus, who stands calmly instructing him. The nets are overflowing with fish, and two other men (James and John) in the background are struggling to pull more nets from the water. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A split illustration showing the two parables of counting the cost. On the right side, a king in royal robes sits on a throne discussing with his generals, looking worriedly at a map showing a large approaching army.
